version.changelog: Full coverage pass: deeper guides, situation-named files, and per-user configuration

llm.summary: This CFO skill is a disclosed advisory finance guide with limited local preference storage and no executable code, network access, bank connections, or money movement.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads local CFO configuration and memory files and may fall back to a shared profile for currency, locale, and timezone. This is purpose-aligned and disclosed, but users should understand that local preference files are part of the workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is markdown and JSON only, with no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, hooks, or service setup identified.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to loading relevant markdown guides, applying user preferences, and producing financial advice or drafts. The skill explicitly says it does not authorize payments, connect to systems, or decide human-in-the-loop matters.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to ~/Clawic/data/cfo/ config and memory for preferences and context, with instructions not to store credentials, account numbers, raw statements, employee-level compensation, or customer-identifiable revenue detail. Writes are limited to stated preferences or user-requested persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently support CFO-style financial guidance: runway, fundraising, budgeting, board reporting, tax escalation, debt, equity, and operations. High-impact financial topics are handled as advice, with explicit human-in-the-loop escalation for decisions and licensed-professional areas.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable with the skill reading and maintaining local CFO preference/context files under ~/Clawic/data/cfo/ and reading shared profile values when needed. Do not store credentials, account numbers, tax IDs, raw bank/payroll exports, or sensitive employee/customer detail in its memory files.
llm.findings:
[P2] expected: The flagged memory-template comments are visible markdown placeholders for company shape and finance stack fields, not hidden directives to override agent behavior.
[P2] expected: The flagged auditor, advisor, and bank comment explicitly limits storage to names only and says never to store credentials or account numbers.
[OH3] expected: The cited 'Buying Time Without Cutting' section is ordinary advisory content, not an instruction to produce unbounded output or flood context.
[SQP-2] expected: Local reads and writes are real, but they are disclosed in SKILL.md and setup.md, restricted to preference/context files, and bounded by instructions to avoid sensitive financial and credential data.
[SQP-1] expected: The FX hedge trigger is a financial heuristic within an advice-only guide; it may be simplified, but it is not a security or agent-control concern.
